== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ローグ2</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">パイロットと乗客を合計で2名乗せられる。ゼヴが操縦しているなら耐：損耗＜3。パイロットが乗っているなら、捜索隊の運命数に2を加えられる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">密閉型。ホスの寒冷対策に施した改造が成功した最初のスノースピーダー。ゼヴ・セネスカが操縦する。ソロ船長とスカイウォーカー中佐の捜索隊を率いた。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Rogue 2.

'''Lore''' — Enclosed. The first snowspeeder whose Hoth cold-weather modifications succeeded. Zev Senesca pilots it. He led the search party for Captain Solo and Commander Skywalker.

'''Game text''' — May carry two pilots or passengers in total. Immune to attrition less than 3 if Zev is piloting. If a pilot is aboard, may add 2 to search party destiny.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Lore specifies successful cold-weather modifications rather than being adapted to Hoth's environment, and uses 中佐. Game text uses パイロットが乗っているなら rather than “If piloted”.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-rogue2-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Rogue 2]].</ref>
